name: Mike Capuano
desc: former United States Representative from Massachusetts
summary: Michael Everett Capuano ( KAP-ew-AH-noh; born January 9, 1952) is an American politician and attorney  who served as a U.S. representative of Massachusetts from 1999 to 2019. A Democrat, his district included the northern three-fourths of Boston, as well as parts of Cambridge, his hometown of Somerville, and other communities immediately north and south of Boston. Prior to being elected to Congress, he served in Somerville as an alderman and the 33rd mayor.
